architecture.summary: Test only. The SO-12 release rehearsal of 31 October 2026 found that the OPERATION_CAPACITY=5 case of test/acceptance/mcp/hosted-tenant-capacity.test.ts failed on the Render builder with two busy events at the relay spy. The release of the five held calls kept the event loop busy, so the tenant read the answer to its busy relay after the 5 s limit of an audit send and sent the same event again (same operation ID). The case now counts the relayed events one time for each operation ID, as the relay route of the control plane does (AcceptedRelays), and waits for six operations instead of six deliveries; it still requires one busy event and five success events. docs/testing/test-list.md describes the count. No source, support, configuration, workflow, dependency, or Mermaid block changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, or runtime behavior changes, and the registry stays accurate.
